rows.name: NHTSA vPIC
rows.licenseNote: U.S. government public dataset. This snapshot stores passenger car, truck, and multipurpose passenger vehicle model names only. No VINs and no premium figures.
rows.accessMethod: HTTPS GET of the vPIC model list, saved as a versioned catalog snapshot.
rows.refreshCadence: Rebuild when the catalog refresh date arrives. The current snapshot asks for a refresh after 20 March 2027.

rows.name: FuelEconomy.gov vehicles.csv
rows.owner: U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. Environmental Protection Agency
rows.licenseNote: U.S. government public dataset. This snapshot keeps year, make, base model, and model name. Fuel-cost and economy figures are not stored.
rows.accessMethod: HTTPS download of vehicles.csv, described at https://www.fueleconomy.gov/feg/ws/index.shtml.
rows.refreshCadence: Rebuild with the NHTSA snapshot. The current snapshot asks for a refresh after 20 March 2027.

rows.name: BLS CPI, motor vehicle insurance
rows.licenseNote: BLS publications are in the public domain, except previously copyrighted images. Do not use the BLS emblem. This series is not applied until a baseline is cleared. No index value is stored.
rows.refreshCadence: Not refreshed into this bundle until a baseline is cleared.

rows.name: State statutes and insurance departments
rows.licenseNote: Public statute and department pages. The state-rules table is source research, not a premium baseline. Rows without a source URL have no dollar minimum.
rows.accessMethod: Pages opened in a browser and cited on the state-rules row. No bulk download.
rows.refreshCadence: Review the launch rows when a cited statute changes. The current table was checked on 21 September 2026.
